chunks: And Ali, peace be upon him, said:
"I do not concern myself with whether urine or water has touched me if I am unaware of it."

key_terms.بَوْلٌ: urine, as a source of ritual impurity
key_terms.لَمْ أَعْلَمْ: I did not know or was unaware
key_terms.مَا أُبَالِي: I do not mind or give concern

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if I do not know whether urine or water touched me?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when a person does not know whether what touched him was urine or merely water, he does not treat himself as affected by impurity. It reflects a jurisprudential principle of not imposing impurity in the absence of knowledge.
